answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: every agent stakes a copper-colored reputation bond, and rewards drip out over many epochs like fruit ripening in an orchard. A flash-farm of fake identities collects only the first few drips before the game ends, so most earnings stay locked and are forfeited on exit or detected abuse. An attacker must fund thousands of bonds and vine-like growing balances for months to break even, making sybil farming costlier than honest participation.
